text:
Maria (partnerships): Hey team — Greenline (channel partner) just sent a blocker for the co-sell POC. They run in Azure with locked-down egress. They need a presales note that covers: 1) exact egress IPs/domains we need them to allow, 2) whether Private Link or VNet peering is required for the POC, 3) TLS/cert expectations, and 4) any cost impact (NAT gateway, transfer charges). Can SRE/eng/security help triage? @Tom (solutions) @Sam (security) :eyes:

Tom (solutions): Quick clarifying q: is this for Redwood Hosted API access (we're calling out to our hosted endpoints) or for a Redwood Private deployment inside their VNet? Greenline's email is a little fuzzy on that point.

Maria (partnerships): They said "co-sell POC" and expect minimal lift — likely Redwood Hosted but within a customer-managed VNet egress policy. They prefer no inbound peering.

Alex (eng): For Hosted: we can support strict outbound allowlisting. We require outbound HTTPS (TLS 1.2+) to our API endpoints and a couple of model artifact/CDN domains. We can provide the IP ranges. If they want maximum security we can offer Private Link (longer lead) or recommend a small NAT egress rule set.

Alex (eng): Sample minimal allowlist (to share with partner):
```
# allowlist example for Azure firewall
ALLOW_TO: api.redwood.com (443)
ALLOW_TO: model-artifacts.redwood-cdn.net (443)
ALLOW_TO: telemetry.redwood-internal.net (443)
# or by IPs
13.54.129.23/32
52.23.181.10/32
34.198.123.45/32
```
Note: we prefer FQDN-based filtering + TLS inspection isn't required on our side.

Sam (security): We'll need to send the security questionnaire answers and a short data flow diagram. Also confirm: no customer data should be written back to their VNet from our side. Key items partner usually asks: SOC2 status, recent pen test, KMS/keys for Private deployments, TLS min versions, and audit logs retention. I can start drafting answers.

Jenna (sales): Pricing ask: Greenline wants to know delta between Hosted + NAT egress vs Dedicated (reserved). They expect heavy traffic for a 2-week POC. Can we give a ballpark for egress-sensitive pricing? Even a sentence like "NAT + egress bandwidth is billed by Azure; for large throughput consider Dedicated to reduce per-request latency and predictable GPU costs" helps.

Tom (solutions): Action items I propose: 1) Alex — produce a one-page allowlist + FQDN list + Bicep snippet for Azure Firewall by EOD; 2) Sam — security FAQ + data flow diagram; 3) Jenna — draft pricing blurb (hosted vs dedicated) with an example cost table for 10M tokens/day; 4) Maria — schedule a 30-min handoff call with Greenline + partner on Tue 09:00 PT. Agree?

Maria (partnerships): Yes please. I'll book Tue 9am PT. Greenline requested SAML metadata too (SSO for their engineers). That's another quick doc we should attach.

Alex (eng): I can attach a tiny Bicep snippet for Azure Firewall/NAT egress — example below:
```
resource firewall 'Microsoft.Network/azureFirewalls@2021-08-01' = {
  name: 'allow-redwood-egress'
  properties: {
    sku: { name: 'AZFW_VNet' }
    ipConfigurations: []
    firewallPolicy: {}
  }
}
// add applicationRuleCollections for api.redwood.com, model-artifacts.redwood-cdn.net
```
I'll also export the current hosted egress IP list; infra-bot can publish it to the shared bucket.

infra-bot: Published egress-ip-list to s3://redwood-partner-assets/greenline/egress-list-1712349876.json :white_check_mark:

Sam (security): I'll attach SOC2 report excerpt and quick answers. One ask: if they insist on Private Link, we'll need a security review and an ETA ~3–4 weeks. For the POC timeline (2 weeks) Private Link may be a blocker.

Jenna (sales): Noted — we'll present Hosted + allowlist as the POC path and include a Dedicated option if they want lower-latency with reserved capacity. I'll put together the pricing note and share in this thread.

Tom (solutions): I'll compile Alex + Sam materials into a single handoff doc and post before the call. Also: do we have a standard SAML metadata URL we can give them for quick test?

Alex (eng): Yes — send them https://sso.redwood.com/saml/metadata and mention we support SP-initiated SAML and SCIM provisioning (requires enterprise plan).

Maria (partnerships): Awesome. Thanks everyone — goal is to unblock Greenline's security team and get the POC scheduled tomorrow. I'll DM the partner with the Tue invite once docs are up. :thumbsup:
